headline: As of 2026-10-14: 5,172,567 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 37 of 50 states, D+22.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 5,172,567 early/mail ballots cast so far across 37 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+22.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (668,262), Virginia (568,467), Michigan (520,417).
